navbar.notes: navy-900 bar, 64px, 2px brand-red bottom border; navbar__brand (warehouse icon + 'StockFlow') left, navbar__links right, active link brand red via navbar__link--active / aria-current=page

page.notes: warm-oat bg, centered 960px column, page__header with page__title and app icon

card.notes: white, --radius-lg, --shadow-sm, hover lift (shadow-md, translateY -2px); holds stock table and detail panels

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand red, 0 radius), btn--secondary (outlined navy-200), btn--ghost, btn--danger, btn--danger-outline, btn--sm; min 44px tap target; disabled+spinner (aria-busy) in flight

form_input.notes: field__label persistent (never placeholder-only), field__input info-color focus ring, field--error (error border + error-light fill) with field__error naming the field inline

alert.notes: inline alert for page-load failure and validation only; role=alert

stock_table.notes: cool uppercase header; .num cells right-aligned, DM Mono tabular-nums; row-flash on in-place update

status_pill.variants: pill--in-stock, pill--low, pill--out, pill--on-order, pill--quarantined, pill--not-tracked; meaning carried by text label + color + border style, never color alone

new_to_verify_pill.notes: F6: info-blue pill reading 'New - verify' on the Batch and Serial column headers/cells

to_be_retired_pill.notes: F6: dashed neutral pill reading 'To be retired' on the combined tracking code column; absent after F10

stage_label.notes: F6/F10: small uppercase chip beside the home page__title, text 'Today' or 'Transition - to verify'; text carries the meaning

migration_overlay.notes: F6: fixed full-screen navy scrim with spinner (migration-overlay__spinner) and step text, role=status aria-live=polite; shown while a migration step runs, hidden when it finishes; no layout shift

empty_state.notes: icon + teaching heading + copy + CTA; never a blank region; 'No stock at this location - receive an inbound shipment'

scan_zone.notes: green flash on success, red flash on failure paired with persistent error toast

toast.notes: inside fixed top-right toast-region; role=status / role=alert; no layout shift

feedback_matrix.notes: Feedback matrix (no silent failures): form_submit: success=navigate to confirmation view | failure=inline alert + field-named error; barcode_scan: success=row updates in place + green scan-zone flash | failure=red scan-zone flash + persistent error toast; inline_mutation: success=auto-dismiss success toast (~3s) | failure=persistent error toast; delete_remove: success=success toast + optimistic update | failure=persistent toast + local revert; page_load: success=n/a | failure=inline alert replaces content area; button_action: success=disabled + spinner while in flight | failure=re-enabled + error shown

browse_provenance.notes: browsed:https://www.databricks.com (raw CSS: #1b3139, #f9f7f4, #ff3621, #eeede9, DM Sans) -> brand+color; browsed:https://brand.databricks.com (raw markup: DM Sans, #1B3139, #F9F7F4) -> typography+palette; browsed:https://www.cin7.com (marketing page: card-grouped feature areas, horizontal top nav; no dashboard UI visible) -> layout cue only; browse-gap:https://www.linnworks.com (marketing copy only, no product UI); browse-gap:https://www.fishbowlinventory.com (not fetched); browse-gap: no reference showed a real stock table, so table density comes from the brief
